q: 外面雨太大，我什么都看___见。
zh: 外面雨太大，我什么都看不见。
py: wài miàn yǔ tài dà wǒ shén me dōu kàn bù jiàn
en: The rain outside is so heavy that I can't see anything.
why: The heavy rain is the reason for failing, so 不 goes between 看 and 见. 得 would say you can see, contradicting 什么都; 没 never sits inside verb + result.

q: 我鼻子堵住了，什么味道都闻___到。
zh: 我鼻子堵住了，什么味道都闻不到。
py: wǒ bí zi dǔ zhù le shén me wèi dao dōu wén bù dào
en: My nose is blocked; I can't smell anything.
why: A blocked nose means the smell cannot be reached: 闻不到. 闻得到 would claim you can smell, and 很 cannot be inserted inside a potential form.

q: 雾这么大，前面的路我看___清楚。
zh: 雾这么大，前面的路我看不清楚。
py: wù zhè me dà qián miàn de lù wǒ kàn bù qīng chu
en: The fog is so thick that I can't see the road ahead clearly.
why: Thick fog explains the inability, so 看不清楚. 看得清楚 says the opposite; 没 and 很 cannot stand between the verb and its result in a potential form.

q: 雪停了，路上的车终于开___动了。
zh: 雪停了，路上的车终于开得动了。
py: xuě tíng le lù shàng de chē zhōng yú kāi de dòng le
en: The snow has stopped, and the cars can finally move again.
why: 终于 and 雪停了 report that the obstacle is gone, so the positive 开得动 fits. 开不动 would mean they still cannot move; 没 and 很 do not fit between verb and result.

q: 医生说的话，我一句也没听___。
zh: 医生说的话，我一句也没听懂。
py: yī shēng shuō de huà wǒ yī jù yě méi tīng dǒng
en: I didn't understand a single sentence the doctor said.
why: 没 reports that one occasion did not succeed, so it takes bare verb + result: 没听懂. 没 cannot be combined with 得 or 不 (没听不懂), and 听不了 is a different meaning.

q: 我太累了，爬___上去了。
zh: 我太累了，爬不上去了。
py: wǒ tài lèi le pá bù shàng qù le
en: I'm too tired; I can't climb up any more.
why: Exhaustion is the obstacle, so 不 goes right after 爬: 爬不上去. 爬得上去 would say you can still manage it, which clashes with 太累了.

q: 我的腿受伤了，站___起来。
zh: 我的腿受伤了，站不起来。
py: wǒ de tuǐ shòu shāng le zhàn bù qǐ lái
en: My leg is injured and I can't stand up.
why: An injured leg is a physical obstacle: 站不起来. 站得起来 says the opposite, and 不能 cannot sit between 站 and 起来.

q: 年纪大了，他的名字我怎么也想___起来了。
zh: 年纪大了，他的名字我怎么也想不起来了。
py: nián jì dà le tā de míng zi wǒ zěn me yě xiǎng bù qǐ lái le
en: I'm getting old; I just can't recall his name any more.
why: 怎么也 plus an age-related memory loss needs the negative 想不起来. 想得起来 would be positive and contradicts 怎么也, and 没 cannot split 想 from 起来.

q: 别担心，这点雨不大，我们走___回去。
zh: 别担心，这点雨不大，我们走得回去。
py: bié dān xīn zhè diǎn yǔ bù dà wǒ men zǒu de huí qù
en: Don't worry, this rain isn't heavy; we can walk back.
why: The reassurance 别担心 and 雨不大 call for the positive 走得回去. 走不回去 would say they cannot, which contradicts the comfort being offered.

q: 风太大了，我们的帐篷怎么也搭___起来。
zh: 风太大了，我们的帐篷怎么也搭不起来。
py: fēng tài dà le wǒ men de zhàng peng zěn me yě dā bù qǐ lái
en: The wind is so strong that we just can't get our tent up.
why: A strong wind is a physical obstacle: 搭不起来. 搭得起来 contradicts 怎么也, and 不能搭起来 would sound like a ban instead of a failed attempt.

q: 我肚子疼，一口饭也吃___。
zh: 我肚子疼，一口饭也吃不下。
py: wǒ dù zi téng yī kǒu fàn yě chī bù xià
en: My stomach hurts; I can't get down a single bite.
why: 下 in the potential means room or ability to take food in, so 吃不下. 吃不起 means cannot afford it, and 吃不到 means cannot get hold of it.

q: 已经七点五十了，八点的飞机，现在去机场___了。
zh: 已经七点五十了，八点的飞机，现在去机场来不及了。
py: yǐ jīng qī diǎn wǔ shí le bā diǎn de fēi jī xiàn zài qù jī chǎng lái bù jí le
en: It is already ten to eight and the flight is at eight; it's too late to go to the airport now.
why: Only ten minutes left before takeoff, so there is no time: 来不及. 来得及 says there is time, 来不了 says you cannot come, and 对不起 is an apology.

q: 你别急，现在出门还___。
zh: 你别急，现在出门还来得及。
py: nǐ bié jí xiàn zài chū mén hái lái de jí
en: Don't worry; if you leave now there is still time.
why: 别急 means there is still time, so 还来得及. 来不及 says it is too late, 来不了 means unable to come, and 来得了 is not the time expression.

q: 天气预报说一小时后会下大雨，我们现在跑回家还___。
zh: 天气预报说一小时后会下大雨，我们现在跑回家还来得及。
py: tiān qì yù bào shuō yī xiǎo shí hòu huì xià dà yǔ wǒ men xiàn zài pǎo huí jiā hái lái de jí
en: The forecast says heavy rain in an hour; if we run home now we can still make it.
why: An hour of margin means there is enough time: 还来得及. 来不及 would say it is too late, and 来得了 asks about ability rather than time.

q: 冬天的大衣太贵了，他买___。
zh: 冬天的大衣太贵了，他买不起。
py: dōng tiān de dà yī tài guì le tā mǎi bù qǐ
en: Winter coats are too expensive; he can't afford one.
why: 太贵 gives the reason: the price is beyond his budget, so 买不起. 买不到 would mean none are on sale, and 买不下 has no such meaning.

q: 空调都卖完了，我们哪儿都买___。
zh: 空调都卖完了，我们哪儿都买不到。
py: kōng tiáo dōu mài wán le wǒ men nǎ r dōu mǎi bù dào
en: The air conditioners are all sold out; we can't buy one anywhere.
why: 卖完了 means none are available, so 买不到. 买不起 is about price, and the others are not set forms with 买.

q: 晚上咖啡喝多了，我怎么也睡___。
zh: 晚上咖啡喝多了，我怎么也睡不着。
py: wǎn shang kā fēi hē duō le wǒ zěn me yě shuì bù zháo
en: I drank too much coffee in the evening and can't fall asleep no matter what.
why: 睡不着 (zháo) is the set form for being unable to fall asleep. 睡不下, 睡不起 and 睡不动 are not used for insomnia.

q: 我刚吃完饭，再好吃的蛋糕也吃___了。
zh: 我刚吃完饭，再好吃的蛋糕也吃不下了。
py: wǒ gāng chī wán fàn zài hǎo chī de dàn gāo yě chī bù xià le
en: I just finished eating; I couldn't manage any more, however nice the cake.
why: 刚吃完饭 means the stomach has no room left: 吃不下. 吃不完 is about a large amount that cannot be finished, and 吃不起 is about price.

q: 这个西瓜太大了，我们三个人吃两天也吃___。
zh: 这个西瓜太大了，我们三个人吃两天也吃不完。
py: zhè ge xī guā tài dà le wǒ men sān ge rén chī liǎng tiān yě chī bù wán
en: This watermelon is so big that three of us couldn't finish it in two days.
why: Too much food to finish is 吃不完. 吃不起 would be about money, 吃不到 about getting hold of it, and 吃不动 is not said of food.

q: 明天下大雪，我们去___。
zh: 明天下大雪，我们去不了。
py: míng tiān xià dà xuě wǒ men qù bù liǎo
en: It's going to snow heavily tomorrow, so we can't go.
why: 去 has no result word, so inability is 去不了 (liǎo). 不到 is not a complement for 去, 不起 means cannot afford, and 不下 means no room.

q: 我胃不好，太辣的菜我吃___。
zh: 我胃不好，太辣的菜我吃不了。
py: wǒ wèi bù hǎo tài là de cài wǒ chī bù liǎo
en: My stomach is bad; I can't eat very spicy food.
why: With no specific result, 吃不了 says the action cannot be done. 吃不起 would be about price, which has nothing to do with a bad stomach.

q: 今年冬天太冷了，我真受___。
zh: 今年冬天太冷了，我真受不了。
py: jīn nián dōng tiān tài lěng le wǒ zhēn shòu bù liǎo
en: This winter is so cold that I really can't stand it.
why: 受不了 (liǎo) is the set phrase for can't stand. 受不起 means cannot bear an honour or a favour, so it does not fit complaining about cold.

q: 下雨天路滑，山路根本走___，还是别去了。
zh: 下雨天路滑，山路根本走不了，还是别去了。
py: xià yǔ tiān lù huá shān lù gēn běn zǒu bù liǎo hái shi bié qù le
en: The road is slippery in the rain and the mountain path is impossible to walk; let's not go.
why: The slippery road makes walking impossible, with no result word to name: 走不了. 走不起 and 走不下 do not have this meaning.

q: 那年冬天的第一场雪，我永远忘___。
zh: 那年冬天的第一场雪，我永远忘不了。
py: nà nián dōng tiān de dì yī chǎng xuě wǒ yǒng yuǎn wàng bù liǎo
en: I will never forget the first snow of that winter.
why: 忘不了 (liǎo) is the fixed phrase for cannot forget. 忘不到, 忘不起 and 忘不下 do not exist.

q: 你一个人拿得___这么多东西吗？
zh: 你一个人拿得了这么多东西吗？
py: nǐ yī ge rén ná de liǎo zhè me duō dōng xi ma
en: Can you carry this many things by yourself?
why: Too much to handle with no specific result is V得了 (liǎo) in a question. 拿得起, 拿得下 and 拿得到 mean other things (lift up, hold, reach).

q: 医生说你感冒了，今天___去游泳。
zh: 医生说你感冒了，今天不能去游泳。
py: yī shēng shuō nǐ gǎn mào le jīn tiān bù néng qù yóu yǒng
en: The doctor says you have a cold, so you must not go swimming today.
why: 医生说 gives an instruction, so it is 不能 + verb (not allowed). 不了, 不起 and 不到 are complements and cannot stand before 去.

q: 病人刚睡着，你们___大声说话。
zh: 病人刚睡着，你们不能大声说话。
py: bìng rén gāng shuì zháo nǐ men bù néng dà shēng shuō huà
en: The patient has just fallen asleep; you mustn't talk loudly.
why: This is a request to refrain, not an inability, so 不能 + verb. A complement like 不了 cannot go before 大声说话.

q: 这个箱子里装满了书，太重了，我一个人搬___。
zh: 这个箱子里装满了书，太重了，我一个人搬不动。
py: zhè ge xiāng zi lǐ zhuāng mǎn le shū tài zhòng le wǒ yī ge rén bān bù dòng
en: This box is full of books and too heavy; I can't lift it by myself.
why: Heaviness is a physical obstacle, so 搬不动. 搬不能 is ungrammatical and 搬不起 means cannot afford.

q: 医生说你的腿还没好，现在___爬山。
zh: 医生说你的腿还没好，现在不能爬山。
py: yī shēng shuō nǐ de tuǐ hái méi hǎo xiàn zài bù néng pá shān
en: The doctor says your leg isn't better yet, so you shouldn't climb mountains now.
why: The doctor is giving advice about what you should not do: 不能 + verb. Complements such as 不了 or 不动 cannot be placed before 爬山.

q: 他的腿骨折了，现在站___，更不用说走路了。
zh: 他的腿骨折了，现在站不起来，更不用说走路了。
py: tā de tuǐ gǔ zhé le xiàn zài zhàn bù qǐ lái gèng bù yòng shuō zǒu lù le
en: His leg is broken; he can't even stand up now, let alone walk.
why: A broken leg is a physical obstacle, so 站不起来. 不能起来 is not the complement form, 没起来 would report one occasion, and 不上来 has the wrong direction.

q: 台风来了，学校通知今天___出门。
zh: 台风来了，学校通知今天不能出门。
py: tái fēng lái le xué xiào tōng zhī jīn tiān bù néng chū mén
en: A typhoon is coming; the school has notified everyone not to go out today.
why: A school notice is an instruction, so 不能 + verb. 不了 and the other complements cannot stand directly before 出门.

q: 这里是病房，晚上八点以后外人___进去。
zh: 这里是病房，晚上八点以后外人不能进去。
py: zhè lǐ shì bìng fáng wǎn shang bā diǎn yǐ hòu wài rén bù néng jìn qù
en: This is a ward; outsiders may not go in after eight at night.
why: A visiting rule forbids entry, so 不能 + 进去. The potential 进不去 would say outsiders physically cannot get in, not that it is against the rules.

q: 他的汉字写___很好，老师很喜欢。
zh: 他的汉字写得很好，老师很喜欢。
py: tā de hàn zì xiě de hěn hǎo lǎo shī hěn xǐ huan
en: He writes Chinese characters very well, and the teacher likes them.
why: 很 shows this is the degree 得 (how well he writes). A potential form never takes 很, so 不 and 没 cannot fit.

q: 昨天雨太大，路灯又坏了，司机开车开___很慢。
zh: 昨天雨太大，路灯又坏了，司机开车开得很慢。
py: zuó tiān yǔ tài dà lù dēng yòu huài le sī jī kāi chē kāi de hěn màn
en: Yesterday the rain was heavy and the street lights were out, so the driver drove very slowly.
why: 开得很慢 describes how he drove (degree 得 with 很). 开不很慢 and 开没很慢 are not forms; the potential never takes 很.

q: 我今天嗓子哑了，再怎么用力也唱___好。
zh: 我今天嗓子哑了，再怎么用力也唱不好。
py: wǒ jīn tiān sǎng zi yǎ le zài zěn me yòng lì yě chàng bù hǎo
en: My throat is hoarse today, so I can't sing well however hard I try.
why: 再怎么…也 describes failing to reach a result, so the potential 唱不好 is needed. 得很 is the degree pattern and 唱得好 contradicts the sentence.

q: 我想不起来___他的名字了。
zh: 我想不起来他的名字了。
py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái tā de míng zi le
en: I can't remember his name any more.
why: The sentence-final 了 comes after the object (他的名字了). Putting 了 right after 想不起来 splits the block from its object and is wrong.

q: 这本医学书太难了，我___看不懂。
zh: 这本医学书太难了，我看不懂。
py: zhè běn yī xué shū tài nán le wǒ kàn bù dǒng
en: This medical book is too hard; I can't understand it.
why: A potential complement says only whether something is possible, so 把 cannot be used with it. 被 and 对 do not make a sentence here either.

q: 他说得太快，他的话我___。
zh: 他说得太快，他的话我听不懂。
py: tā shuō de tài kuài tā de huà wǒ tīng bù dǒng
en: He speaks too fast; I can't understand what he says.
why: With the object fronted as a topic, the verb block 听不懂 stands whole at the end. 听他不懂 splits it, 不听懂 puts 不 before the verb, and 听得很懂 contradicts 太快.

q: 风声太大了，你听___见我说话吗？
zh: 风声太大了，你听得见我说话吗？
py: fēng shēng tài dà le nǐ tīng de jiàn wǒ shuō huà ma
en: The wind is loud; can you hear me?
why: A yes/no question with 吗 uses the positive form 听得见. 没 and 很 cannot stand inside verb + result.

q: 雨这么大，你走___走得回去？
zh: 雨这么大，你走不走得回去？
py: yǔ zhè me dà nǐ zǒu bù zǒu de huí qù
en: The rain is so heavy; can you walk back?
why: V不V得R repeats the verb: 走不走得回去. 得 or 很 in the first slot would not make a question, and the verb itself must be repeated.

q: 老师，这么多新词，我们一个晚上记___记得住？
zh: 老师，这么多新词，我们一个晚上记不记得住？
py: lǎo shī zhè me duō xīn cí wǒ men yī ge wǎn shang jì bù jì de zhù
en: Teacher, can we remember this many new words in one evening?
why: The colloquial A-not-A question repeats the verb: 记不记得住. 得, 能 or 很 in that slot does not form a question.

q: 外面太吵，朋友问我听得见吗，我说听___见。
zh: 外面太吵，朋友问我听得见吗，我说听不见。
py: wài miàn tài chǎo péng you wèn wǒ tīng de jiàn ma wǒ shuō tīng bù jiàn
en: It was too noisy; my friend asked if I could hear, and I said I couldn't.
why: The answer repeats the potential form, and the noise says it is the negative: 听不见. 是 and 不是 cannot answer a potential question.

q: 这个药的说明这么小，你看得清楚看___清楚？
zh: 这个药的说明这么小，你看得清楚看不清楚？
py: zhè ge yào de shuō míng zhè me xiǎo nǐ kàn de qīng chu kàn bù qīng chu
en: The instructions on this medicine are so small; can you read them clearly or not?
why: The positive + negative question needs the full pair 看得清楚看不清楚. Putting 没, 得 or 很 in the second slot does not give the negative pair.

q: 他的病这么重，明天来得了来___？
zh: 他的病这么重，明天来得了来不了？
py: tā de bìng zhè me zhòng míng tiān lái de liǎo lái bù liǎo
en: He is so ill; can he come tomorrow or not?
why: The pair must be complete: 来得了来不了. A bare 不 or 吗 cannot finish it, and 没了 or 不得 are not forms.

q: 外面这么吵，你睡得___吗？
zh: 外面这么吵，你睡得着吗？
py: wài miàn zhè me chǎo nǐ shuì de zháo ma
en: It's so noisy outside; can you get to sleep?
why: 睡得着 (zháo) is the potential form for being able to fall asleep. 起, 懂 and 见 are not the result of 睡.

zh: 我听不懂医生的话。
py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng yī shēng de huà
en: I can't understand what the doctor says.
why: The object goes after the whole 听不懂 block, or in front as a topic. It cannot split 听 and 不懂.

zh: 雨太大了，我们回不去了。
py: yǔ tài dà le wǒ men huí bù qù le
en: The rain is too heavy; we can't get back.
why: The reason clause comes first, then the subject and 回不去了. 不 sits between 回 and 去, and the sentence-final 了 closes the block.

zh: 这么冷的天，你睡得着睡不着？
py: zhè me lěng de tiān nǐ shuì de zháo shuì bù zháo
en: In such cold weather, can you sleep or not?
why: The positive and negative potential forms stand side by side with no 吗. The time phrase may come before or after 你.

zh: 吃药的时候不能喝酒。
py: chī yào de shí hou bù néng hē jiǔ
en: You must not drink alcohol while taking medicine.
why: A medical instruction is 不能 + verb (not allowed). The time clause comes first, and 不能 stands directly before 喝酒.

zh: 这么多水，我一次喝不了。
py: zhè me duō shuǐ wǒ yī cì hē bù liǎo
en: I can't drink this much water at one time.
why: Too much to manage is V不了 (liǎo). The object can be a topic in front or follow 喝不了, but 不了 cannot be separated from 喝.

zh: 手冻僵了，字我写不好。
py: shǒu dòng jiāng le zì wǒ xiě bù hǎo
en: My hands are frozen stiff; I can't write the characters well.
why: The stiff hands are why the result cannot be reached, so the potential 写不好 is used, with 字 fronted or after the block.

zh: 我买不起这副眼镜。
py: wǒ mǎi bù qǐ zhè fù yǎn jìng
en: I can't afford these glasses.
why: 买不起 is the set form for cannot afford; the object follows it or is fronted as a topic, and 不起 stays attached to 买.

zh: 雾太大了，我看不见前面。
py: wù tài dà le wǒ kàn bù jiàn qián miàn
en: The fog is so thick that I can't see ahead.
why: 不 sits between 看 and 见, and 前面 follows the block (or is fronted as a topic).

zh: 这些药我吃不完。
py: zhè xiē yào wǒ chī bù wán
en: I can't finish all these pills.
why: 吃不完 is one block; the object may be fronted, follow the subject, or follow the block, but never sit between 吃 and 不完.

zh: 医生说你现在不能吃辣的。
py: yī shēng shuō nǐ xiàn zài bù néng chī là de
en: The doctor says you can't eat spicy food right now.
why: The doctor's instruction is not-allowed, so 不能 + verb. The time word stands before 不能, either before or after 你.

src_py: wǒ zhǎo dào le wǒ de sǎn
task: Say you cannot find it.
zh: 我找不到我的伞。
py: wǒ zhǎo bù dào wǒ de sǎn
en: I can't find my umbrella.
why: Inability is 不 between verb and result: 找不到. The 了 of the completed action goes away, and the object follows the block or is fronted.

src: 他的声音很大，我听得见。
src_py: tā de shēng yīn hěn dà wǒ tīng de jiàn
task: Say his voice is too quiet, so you cannot hear.
zh: 他的声音太小，我听不见。
py: tā de shēng yīn tài xiǎo wǒ tīng bù jiàn
en: His voice is too quiet; I can't hear him.
why: Flip 得 to 不: 听不见. The reason clause 他的声音太小 explains why the result cannot be reached.

src_py: yǔ tíng le wǒ men zǒu de huí qù
task: It is still raining: say you cannot walk back.
zh: 雨还在下，我们走不回去。
py: yǔ hái zài xià wǒ men zǒu bù huí qù
en: It's still raining; we can't walk back.
why: The ongoing rain is the obstacle, so 得 becomes 不 right after 走: 走不回去.

src: 这个沙发很小，我们搬得进去。
src_py: zhè ge shā fā hěn xiǎo wǒ men bān de jìn qù
task: Say it is too big to be moved in.
zh: 这个沙发太大了，我们搬不进去。
py: zhè ge shā fā tài dà le wǒ men bān bù jìn qù
en: This sofa is too big; we can't move it in.
why: 搬得进去 becomes 搬不进去 once the sofa is too big. 不 goes between 搬 and 进去, not before 搬.

src: 这双靴子很便宜，我买得起。
src_py: zhè shuāng xuē zi hěn pián yi wǒ mǎi de qǐ
task: Say it is too expensive, so you cannot afford it.
zh: 这双靴子太贵了，我买不起。
py: zhè shuāng xuē zi tài guì le wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
en: These boots are too expensive; I can't afford them.
why: Price beyond reach is 买不起; 起 here means afford, and 不 replaces 得.

src_py: xiàn zài qù yī yuàn hái lái de jí
task: Say it is already too late.
zh: 现在去医院已经来不及了。
py: xiàn zài qù yī yuàn yǐ jīng lái bù jí le
en: It is already too late to go to the hospital now.
why: 来得及 becomes 来不及 for no time left, with 已经 and a closing 了 marking the change.

src_py: wǒ míng tiān qù xué xiào
task: Say you cannot go (you are ill).
zh: 我明天去不了学校。
py: wǒ míng tiān qù bù liǎo xué xiào
en: I can't go to school tomorrow.
why: Being unable to go is 去不了 (liǎo), with the object after the block. 不去 would say you choose not to.

src_py: wǒ men chī de liǎo zhè me duō cài
task: Make it negative (cannot manage).
zh: 我们吃不了这么多菜。
py: wǒ men chī bù liǎo zhè me duō cài
en: We can't eat this many dishes.
why: Negating V得了 means swapping 得 for 不: 吃不了, not 不吃了 or 没吃得了.

src_py: wǒ bù qù hǎi biān le
task: Say you caught a cold and are unable to go (not that you decided against it).
zh: 我感冒了，去不了海边了。
py: wǒ gǎn mào le qù bù liǎo hǎi biān le
en: I've caught a cold, so I can't go to the seaside any more.
why: 去不了 (liǎo) is inability; 不去了 (le) was a decision. The final 了 comes after the object.

src: 考试的时候，你可以看手机。
src_py: kǎo shì de shí hou nǐ kě yǐ kàn shǒu jī
task: Say it is not allowed.
zh: 考试的时候，你不能看手机。
py: kǎo shì de shí hou nǐ bù néng kàn shǒu jī
en: You can't look at your phone during the exam.
why: The opposite of permission 可以 is 不能 + verb; a rule is not a complement like 看不了.

src_py: yī shēng shuō nǐ kě yǐ chū yuàn le
task: Say the doctor says you are not allowed to leave hospital.
zh: 医生说你不能出院。
py: yī shēng shuō nǐ bù néng chū yuàn
en: The doctor says you can't leave the hospital.
why: The doctor decides, so permission becomes 不能 + verb. 出不去 would say you are physically unable.

src_py: wǒ de tuǐ hěn hǎo wǒ zǒu de dòng
task: Say your leg hurts so much that you cannot walk any further.
zh: 我的腿太疼了，走不动了。
py: wǒ de tuǐ tài téng le zǒu bù dòng le
en: My leg hurts too much; I can't walk any further.
why: Pain is a physical obstacle, so 走不动: 得 becomes 不, and 了 marks the new situation at the end.

src_py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo
task: Say his throat hurts, so he cannot sing well today.
zh: 他嗓子疼，今天唱不好。
py: tā sǎng zi téng jīn tiān chàng bù hǎo
en: His throat hurts; he can't sing well today.
why: The sore throat blocks the result, so the potential 唱不好 is used. 唱得很好 was a degree statement and 很 cannot stay.

src_py: tā xiě hàn zì xiě de hěn hǎo
task: Say he does not write them well.
zh: 他写汉字写得不好。
py: tā xiě hàn zì xiě de bù hǎo
en: He doesn't write Chinese characters well.
why: This judges how he writes, so the degree pattern 写得不好 is kept. The potential 写不好 would say he cannot manage it.

src: 这个问题我说得很清楚。
src_py: zhè ge wèn tí wǒ shuō de hěn qīng chu
task: Say you cannot explain it clearly.
zh: 这个问题我说不清楚。
py: zhè ge wèn tí wǒ shuō bù qīng chu
en: I can't explain this matter clearly.
why: Inability needs the potential 说不清楚; 得很 (degree) must be dropped, because 很 cannot sit inside a potential form.

src_py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ tā de míng zi le
task: Use 想不起来 with the object after it.
zh: 我想不起来他的名字了。
py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái tā de míng zi le
en: I can't remember his name any more.
why: 想不起来 is one block; 了 comes after the object, never between the block and the object.

src_py: zhè piān wén zhāng wǒ kàn dǒng le
task: Say you cannot understand it; put the object after the verb block.
zh: 我看不懂这篇文章。
py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè piān wén zhāng
en: I can't understand this article.
why: 看懂了 turns into 看不懂 with the 了 dropped, and the object follows the whole block.

src: 我看不懂这个药的说明。
src_py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè ge yào de shuō míng
task: Put the object first as the topic.
zh: 这个药的说明我看不懂。
py: zhè ge yào de shuō míng wǒ kàn bù dǒng
en: I can't understand the instructions for this medicine.
why: A long definite object is often fronted as a topic, leaving the block 看不懂 intact; 把 is not allowed here.

src: 老师的问题我回答不了。
src_py: lǎo shī de wèn tí wǒ huí dá bù liǎo
task: Move the object after the verb block.
zh: 我回答不了老师的问题。
py: wǒ huí dá bù liǎo lǎo shī de wèn tí
en: I can't answer the teacher's question.
why: 回答不了 stays whole and the object follows it; putting 老师的问题 between 回答 and 不了 would split the block.

src_py: nǐ tīng de jiàn wǒ shuō huà
task: Make it a yes/no question with 吗.
zh: 你听得见我说话吗？
py: nǐ tīng de jiàn wǒ shuō huà ma
en: Can you hear me?
why: A yes/no question keeps the positive potential form and adds 吗 at the end.

src: 黑板上的字你看得清楚。
src_py: hēi bǎn shàng de zì nǐ kàn de qīng chu
task: Ask with the positive and negative forms side by side, no 吗.
zh: 黑板上的字你看得清楚看不清楚？
py: hēi bǎn shàng de zì nǐ kàn de qīng chu kàn bù qīng chu
en: Can you see the writing on the board clearly or not?
why: The full pair 看得清楚看不清楚 forms the question, and 吗 must not be added.

src_py: nǐ shuì de zháo
task: Ask with the colloquial V不V得R pattern.
zh: 你睡不睡得着？
py: nǐ shuì bù shuì de zháo
en: Can you fall asleep?
why: V不V得R repeats only the verb: 睡不睡得着. The complement 着 is not doubled.

src_py: wǒ men xiàn zài qù lái de jí
task: Ask with 吗.
zh: 我们现在去，来得及吗？
py: wǒ men xiàn zài qù lái de jí ma
en: If we go now, will we make it in time?
why: The positive 来得及 plus 吗 asks whether there is time. 来不及 is used for the negative answer.

src_py: xuě zhè me dà nǐ kāi de liǎo chē
task: Ask with 吗.
zh: 雪这么大，你开得了车吗？
py: xuě zhè me dà nǐ kāi de liǎo chē ma
en: The snow is so heavy; can you drive?
why: The positive 开得了 plus 吗 asks whether it is possible; the object 车 follows the block before 吗.

src: 这条路这么窄，大车开得过去。
src_py: zhè tiáo lù zhè me zhǎi dà chē kāi de guò qù
task: Ask with the positive and negative forms, no 吗.
zh: 这条路这么窄，大车开得过去开不过去？
py: zhè tiáo lù zhè me zhǎi dà chē kāi de guò qù kāi bù guò qù
en: This road is so narrow; can a big vehicle get through or not?
why: The pair 开得过去开不过去 asks the question; adding 吗 or doubling only 过去 would be wrong.

s: 雾太大了，我们不看见路。
s_py: wù tài dà le wǒ men bù kàn jiàn lù
zh: 雾太大了，我们看不见路。
py: wù tài dà le wǒ men kàn bù jiàn lù
en: The fog is too thick; we can't see the road.
why: Inability puts 不 between 看 and 见. 不看见 in front of the verb is not a potential form.

s: 昨天雨声太大，我一句也没听清楚。
s_py: zuó tiān yǔ shēng tài dà wǒ yī jù yě méi tīng qīng chu
zh: 昨天雨声太大，我一句也没听清楚。
py: zuó tiān yǔ shēng tài dà wǒ yī jù yě méi tīng qīng chu
en: The rain was so loud yesterday that I didn't catch a single sentence.
why: 昨天 and 一句也没 report a single finished occasion, so 没 + verb + result is right; the potential 听不清楚 would describe a general inability.

s: 我的眼镜坏了，什么都看不得清楚。
s_py: wǒ de yǎn jìng huài le shén me dōu kàn bù de qīng chu
zh: 我的眼镜坏了，什么都看不清楚。
py: wǒ de yǎn jìng huài le shén me dōu kàn bù qīng chu
en: My glasses are broken and I can't see anything clearly.
why: 得 and 不 are alternatives; they are never stacked between verb and result.

s: 他的名字我想起不来了。
s_py: tā de míng zi wǒ xiǎng qǐ bù lái le
zh: 他的名字我想不起来了。
py: tā de míng zi wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái le
en: I can't remember his name any more.
why: 不 goes right after the verb, before the whole direction word 起来. 想起不来 splits the direction word.

s: 雪太厚了，车开不出去。
s_py: xuě tài hòu le chē kāi bù chū qù
zh: 雪太厚了，车开不出去。
py: xuě tài hòu le chē kāi bù chū qù
en: The snow is so deep that the car can't get out.
why: Snow is a physical obstacle, so 开不出去 is right. 不能开出去 would sound like a ban.

s: 山太高了，我们爬没上去。
s_py: shān tài gāo le wǒ men pá méi shàng qù
zh: 山太高了，我们爬不上去。
py: shān tài gāo le wǒ men pá bù shàng qù
en: The mountain is too high; we can't climb up.
why: 没 goes before the verb (没爬上去). Inside the block it must be 不.

s: 这么贵的手机，我不买起。
s_py: zhè me guì de shǒu jī wǒ bù mǎi qǐ
zh: 这么贵的手机，我买不起。
py: zhè me guì de shǒu jī wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
en: I can't afford such an expensive phone.
why: 买不起 is a fixed form with 不 inside; 不买起 is not a word.

s: 这间教室坐得下六十个人。
s_py: zhè jiān jiào shì zuò de xià liù shí ge rén
zh: 这间教室坐得下六十个人。
py: zhè jiān jiào shì zuò de xià liù shí ge rén
en: This classroom can seat sixty people.
why: 得 + 下 states that there is room for that many; the positive form is normal for capacity statements.

s: 雨下得太大，我们来不及得回家。
s_py: yǔ xià de tài dà wǒ men lái bù jí de huí jiā
zh: 雨下得太大，我们来不及回家。
py: yǔ xià de tài dà wǒ men lái bù jí huí jiā
en: The rain is so heavy that we have no time to get home.
why: 来不及 is a fixed form followed directly by a verb; no 得 may be added after it.

s: 我感冒了，今天上不了班。
s_py: wǒ gǎn mào le jīn tiān shàng bù liǎo bān
zh: 我感冒了，今天上不了班。
py: wǒ gǎn mào le jīn tiān shàng bù liǎo bān
en: I have a cold and can't go to work today.
why: 上不了班 (liǎo) with the object after the block is correct; the cold is a practical obstacle, not a rule.

s: 这么多菜，我们吃不了完。
s_py: zhè me duō cài wǒ men chī bù liǎo wán
zh: 这么多菜，我们吃不了。
py: zhè me duō cài wǒ men chī bù liǎo
en: There is too much food; we can't eat it all.
why: 吃不了 and 吃不完 are alternatives; 不了 is already the complement, so 完 cannot follow.

s: 那场大雪，我一辈子都忘不了。
s_py: nà chǎng dà xuě wǒ yī bèi zi dōu wàng bù liǎo
zh: 那场大雪，我一辈子都忘不了。
py: nà chǎng dà xuě wǒ yī bèi zi dōu wàng bù liǎo
en: I'll never forget that heavy snowfall.
why: 忘不了 (liǎo) is the normal way to say cannot forget; the object is fronted as a topic.

s: 我去不了了，你们去吧。
s_py: wǒ qù bù liǎo le nǐ men qù ba
zh: 我去不了了，你们去吧。
py: wǒ qù bù liǎo le nǐ men qù ba
en: I can't go any more; you go ahead.
why: The first 了 is liǎo and the last is le (new situation). The double 了 looks odd but is correct.

s: 你感冒了，不能喝冰水。
s_py: nǐ gǎn mào le bù néng hē bīng shuǐ
zh: 你感冒了，不能喝冰水。
py: nǐ gǎn mào le bù néng hē bīng shuǐ
en: You have a cold, so you shouldn't drink iced water.
why: This is advice about what to avoid, so 不能 + verb is right; there is no complement to use.

s: 他的汉字写不很好。
s_py: tā de hàn zì xiě bù hěn hǎo
zh: 他的汉字写得很好。
py: tā de hàn zì xiě de hěn hǎo
en: He writes Chinese characters very well.
why: 很 belongs to the degree pattern with 得; it cannot follow the potential 不 in 写不很好.

s: 医生说得不清楚，所以我没听懂。
s_py: yī shēng shuō de bù qīng chu suǒ yǐ wǒ méi tīng dǒng
zh: 医生说得不清楚，所以我没听懂。
py: yī shēng shuō de bù qīng chu suǒ yǐ wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: The doctor didn't explain clearly, so I didn't understand.
why: 说得不清楚 judges how he spoke (degree 得), and 没听懂 reports the outcome once; both are correct together.

s: 这个药名太长，我把它记不住。
s_py: zhè ge yào míng tài cháng wǒ bǎ tā jì bù zhù
zh: 这个药名太长，我记不住。
py: zhè ge yào míng tài cháng wǒ jì bù zhù
en: This medicine name is too long; I can't remember it.
why: 把 cannot be used with a potential complement; the object stays as a topic or follows 记不住.

s: 我听他的话不懂。
s_py: wǒ tīng tā de huà bù dǒng
zh: 我听不懂他的话。
py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng tā de huà
en: I can't understand what he says.
why: The object cannot sit between 听 and 不懂; it follows the whole block.

s: 你听得见不见？
s_py: nǐ tīng de jiàn bù jiàn
zh: 你听得见听不见？
py: nǐ tīng de jiàn tīng bù jiàn
en: Can you hear or not?
why: The pair must repeat the whole form: 听得见听不见. The complement alone cannot be doubled.

s: 雪这么厚，你们走不走得回去？
s_py: xuě zhè me hòu nǐ men zǒu bù zǒu de huí qù
zh: 雪这么厚，你们走不走得回去？
py: xuě zhè me hòu nǐ men zǒu bù zǒu de huí qù
en: The snow is so deep; can you walk back?
why: V不V得R is the correct colloquial question; no 吗 is added.
